sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday at 15:00 in what looks a straightforward assignment on paper. Sandbach sit 1st with 31 points from 13 games and arrive in imperious form, having won four of their last five league matches with only a draw interrupting an otherwise perfect run. Bridgnorth, currently 5th with 24 points, have shown decent recent consistency but will face a stern test against the division's strongest outfit.
divisionWide: The title race could shift this weekend with second-placed Bilston Town idle but third-ranked Stafford Town (25 pts) hosting fellow promotion challengers Shawbury United on Saturday. Stafford have been solid lately with four draws and two wins in their last six, while Shawbury are struggling badly—winless in their last four league matches. Eccleshall, sitting 7th with 22 points, travel to face Telford Town on Tuesday evening; Eccleshall have won their last league outing and should fancy their chances against bottom-dwellers Telford, who are in freefall with only one win from their last six. In the middle of the table, Cheadle Heath Nomads host Market Drayton Town and Brereton Social host Dawley Town, both Saturday fixtures where either result seems plausible. Foley Meir host Widnes Town on Saturday; both clubs are in the lower reaches and searching for points, with Widnes particularly desperate—they sit 20th with just 6 points from 11 games.
